what: a window 240 deg round the saddle-shaped inner wall of a torus (R20, r8) between z = -3 and 3, its cut faces taken off, patched g0 and stitched
method: the box x -6..13, y -13..13, z -3..3 opens the inner wall where 12 cos a >= -6 (|a| <= 120 deg): its rim is two arcs on z = +-3 each way and two curves on x = -6, and it bounds no height field. G0: the fill meets the rim. The fill's shape is its own, so no volume is graded. The box opens only the inner wall, so the torus keeps its outer equator (r 28, x and y to +-28) and its top and bottom circles (r 20, z +-8), and the fill of a rim on the inner wall stays inside that box: bbox -28..28, -28..28, -8..8.
